source.provenance: Created locally from scratch by the isolated LibreCAD candidate installed-codec executable converting source.dxf; no downloaded fixture.

experiment.method: Scratch-only focused test imports the existing generated DWG, calls onLoadingCompleted, and attempts a same-version DWG export without editing the drawing or adding APPIDs. It prints typed/raw metadata and the admission report.
experiment.result: PASS as a refusal characterization: unchanged re-export returns false. This is not a successful re-export.

observations: The generated source contains DICTIONARY 0x30 referencing custom PLOTSETTINGS 0x56. The typed PlotSettings callback reports handle 0x56, owner 0x30 and page setup LIBDXFRW_PLOTSETTINGS_86.

The raw PLOTSETTINGS callback retains 50 bytes at handle 0x56; its exposed parent handle is 0 and its typed payload validation flag is false. A zero exposed raw parent is not proof of the on-wire owner.
The admission report records same-version-raw selection for handle 0x56. Final reference validation reports DICTIONARY producer 0x30 committed, target 0x56 unresolved and not committed.
The same failure occurs without the DIMSTYLE edit or extra source APPID used in the prior experiment; neither is needed to reproduce it.
